question: In a certain code language, GOA is written as 7151 and DOG is written as 4157. How will MAN be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is shown below:

The letter GOA is written as 7151. i.e

G ⇒7; O ⇒15; A ⇒1

In the same way, DOG is written as 4157, i.e

D ⇒4; O ⇒15; G ⇒7

Similarly, MAN will be written as __**13114**__, i.e

**M ⇒13; A ⇒1; N ⇒14.**

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option1)**__**'**.
